# Archived GitHub Actions gates

These workflows belong to microphases already closed GREEN. They are preserved byte-for-byte here for auditability but are no longer auto-discovered by GitHub Actions.

During active development, validation runs locally/in the development container. Only Base CI and the current microphase gate remain automatic for the final candidate. To rerun an archived gate manually, restore its original YAML to `.github/workflows/` on a dedicated validation branch.
